name: lifescape
description: Find U.S. towns like the ones you love, then compare finalists on reviewed evidence: gates eliminate, weights rank, evidence decides.
long_description: Lifescape is a local-first place-discovery and retirement-town decision tool. Discovery finds towns from a packaged catalog of Census ACS and NOAA climate data; those results stay leads. Live-fetched evidence stays a proposal until the owner approves each value by name. The strict engine blocks any finalist with failed or unknown critical evidence and ranks only the rest. Reports are written to a Lifescape folder in your home directory. Lifescape never guesses a missing value and never gives a purchase recommendation.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up U.S. places by name and return their place IDs

tools.name: discover_towns
tools.description: Find towns like example towns or wanted qualities (discovery leads only)

tools.name: compare_finalists
tools.description: Gate, rank, and stress-test finalists on reviewed evidence

tools.name: explain_town
tools.description: Show where one town stands on the evidence and what is unresolved

tools.name: inspect_evidence
tools.description: Check an evidence CSV for validation errors and missing metrics

tools.name: fetch_live_evidence
tools.description: Fetch Census ACS and NOAA values as proposals for owner review

tools.name: approve_evidence
tools.description: Record one fetched value as approved by the named human owner

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Return the report file paths of a comparison run
